title: The Half-Light Wardrobe
author: Juniper Zhou
blurb: Ulyana Delacroix, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
